subject: Short continuity statement request — SOC 2 interval gap & bridge letter needs
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@stellardata.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: continuity statement / bridge letter for SOC 2 (post-report period)

Hi Karthik —

We're finishing our security review for the integration with Redwood and have a couple items outstanding on the SOC 2 documentation. Your SOC 2 Type II that covers 2023-10-01 to 2024-03-31 looks good; procurement needs a short continuity/bridge letter to cover the period after the report end date. Specifically they asked for: 

- A signed bridge letter (or short continuity statement) that attests to no material control changes since 2024-04-01 and covers up to the signing date.
- A small set of artifacts: change-control summary for Q2 2024 (or since 2024-04-01), KMS key rotation summary, and a brief incident log (if any) since 2024-04-01.

Do you have a standard bridge letter/template you can provide? We have a procurement deadline of 2024-04-12 for contract signature and they will need the signed document on file before that date. If a signed continuity statement from InfoSec is possible that would work — procurement will accept either a standard bridge letter or an attestation signed by a security leader.

Thanks — appreciate the quick help.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Compliance Manager, StellarData
alyssa.chen@stellardata.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachment: "SOC2_Checklist_Request.pdf" (stub)

From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@stellardata.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2024 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: continuity statement / bridge letter for SOC 2 (post-report period)

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for flagging this and for the timeline. We'll get you a bridge letter. I've attached our latest SOC 2 Type II (report end 2024-03-31) and a standard bridge-letter template we typically use for customers.

Quick clarifying questions so we scope the artifacts correctly:
- For the change-control summary, do you need full RFCs or is a one-page summary of changes/owners/dates sufficient?
- KMS: do you need raw rotation logs or a redacted summary that shows rotation cadence and last rotation date?
- Incident log: confirm whether minor operational incidents that were remediated within our RTOs are required, or only incidents that impacted control objectives.

I'll loop in Marissa (security/compliance) and Laura (legal/product) so we can confirm signatory and finalize wording. If procurement needs a DocuSign-ready doc we can prepare that — do you prefer Redwood to send via DocuSign or will StellarData initiate?

Targeting a draft back to you by EOD 2024-04-05 if we get quick answers to the above.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: "Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20240331.pdf" (stub), "BridgeLetter_Template_Redwood.docx" (stub)

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@stellardata.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@stellardata.com
Date: Wed, 3 Apr 2024 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: continuity statement / bridge letter for SOC 2 (post-report period)

Karthik —

Thanks for the quick reply. Answers below:
- Change-control: one-page summary is fine; we mainly want to see there were no unreviewed changes to control-relevant systems.
- KMS: a redacted summary that includes last rotation date and rotation policy is acceptable.
- Incident log: include any incidents that touch control objectives (availability/confidentiality/integrity). If none, a brief note saying "no control-impacting incidents since 2024-04-01" will do.

Procurement prefers vendor-originated DocuSign where possible (they want the signatures to be from the provider). If Redwood can send the DocuSign envelope that helps speed things up.

Also — procurement asked whether the bridge letter can cover through 2024-06-30 (two months beyond current date) rather than only to the signing date; they find longer coverage helpful for their internal timelines. Would Redwood be comfortable providing a bridge letter that states controls remain unchanged as of the date of signing and affords coverage through 2024-06-30?

Best,
Alyssa

Procurement note: "We need the signed doc uploaded to our SSO portal before 2024-04-12 for the contract to proceed."

From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 3 Apr 2024 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: continuity statement / bridge letter for SOC 2 (post-report period)

Marissa / Rishi —

Forwarding Alyssa's ask from StellarData. Procurement wants a vendor-originated, signed bridge letter (they're asking coverage through 2024-06-30). Can the compliance group prepare a draft that: 

- Affirms no material control changes affecting the SOC 2 scope since 2024-04-01,
- Covers up to 2024-06-30 (language to be precise — see Alyssa's note),
- Is DocuSign-ready and can be signed by Redwood security leadership (we should confirm who signs).

Attachments: I've started a draft based on our template (BridgeLetter_Draft_v1.docx attached). Need the following items from infra/security to complete the package: 
- KMS rotation summary (redacted),
- Change-control one-page summary since 2024-04-01,
- Any control-impacting incident summary or a negative statement if none.

Procurement deadline is tight: they need a signed doc uploaded by 2024-04-12. Can you confirm feasibility and who will sign? My suggestion: Marissa signs (Head of Compliance) and Laura co-signs on legal if required.

Thanks — let me know if you need me to escalate.

-Karthik

Attachment: "BridgeLetter_Draft_v1.docx" (stub)

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 9 Apr 2024 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: continuity statement / bridge letter for SOC 2 (post-report period)

Karthik / Laura —

We can produce the bridge letter and the three artifacts. Quick notes and timeline: 

- KMS rotation summary: infra can provide a redacted export showing rotation cadence and last rotation on 2024-04-07.
- Change-control one-pager: we can produce a consolidated summary of CAB-approved changes touching production controls (will include owner, date, and short rationale).
- Incident statement: there have been two operational incidents since 2024-04-01 but neither impacted control objectives; we'll include a short bullet list and a closing sentence: "No material control-impacting incidents since 2024-04-01."

I updated the draft to change the coverage language to read: "Redwood Inference hereby affirms that, to the best of its knowledge, no material changes were made to the controls comprising the SOC 2 scope as of the date of this letter; this letter is intended to provide continuity for the period between the SOC 2 report end date and the attestation date, with coverage through June 30, 2024, provided no material changes occur prior to that date."

Signatory plan: I can sign as Head of Compliance. Laura, please advise if Legal needs to co-sign; otherwise we will send via DocuSign and have me sign.

ETA: artifacts + signed DocuSign upload by 2024-04-11 EOD.

Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: "BridgeLetter_Draft_v1.docx" (updated stub), "KMS_Rotation_Summary_redacted.csv" (stub)
